classification.difficultyReason: Solve a routine two-step inequality, then translate the inclusive upper bound into a closed endpoint and leftward ray on a number line.

content.prompt: Represent the solution to the inequality $2x+1\le7$ on a number line.

answer.short: $x\le3$; a closed endpoint at $3$ with a ray extending left.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2x+1&\le7\\2x&\le6\\x&\le3\end{align*}$$
The closed endpoint includes $3$; the leftward ray represents all smaller values.

spec.description: Two aligned horizontal levels: a double-ended number line with its sole labelled tick at 3, and a leftward solution ray above it with a closed endpoint aligned at 3. The separate elevated ray is not expressible by the number-line template's point and jump fields.
